WITH filtered_standings AS (
  SELECT r.name, ds.points
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0
),
race_averages AS (
  SELECT name, AVG(points) as race_avg
  FROM filtered_standings
  GROUP BY name
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(race_avg) as overall_average
  FROM race_averages
)
SELECT ra.name, ra.race_avg, ra.race_avg - oa.overall_average as difference
FROM race_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ra.race_avg > oa.overall_average
  AND oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ra.name

assumptions.assumption: Races with identical names appearing in different years are grouped together into a single race-name group for averaging purposes (grouping by races.name rather than races.raceId). The request says 'For each race name', which supports this interpretation.
